items.title: Labarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: You know you take players well like Pat, Wayne Bergeron, Bill Cunliffe, all those guys, you know, they don’t need to see it in front.

ctx.x: Will they have seen the music before they get there?

Never. No. You know you take players well like Pat, Wayne Bergeron, Bill Cunliffe, all those guys, you know, they don’t need to see it in front. And when somebody wants the music in front I get a little suspicious.
Oh that is a quote right there. Most of us don’t live in that world, I can say.
